claimProcedure: Claiming a series arc number = append ONE entry here at branch time (series, number, path, status, claimedAt, branch; mergedPr filled at merge). The guard (bun-apps/s2-agent-ext-wayfind/src/arc-ledger.ts, run by tests/arc-ledger.test.ts) fails CI on any duplicate (series, number) among non-grandfathered entries, on dirs without entries, and on any active number claimed at a different path on origin/main. Renumber = edit the entry and add renumberedTo/note — never delete history. grandfathered:true is legal ONLY for entries with claimedAt <= adopted (pre-ledger claims); new claims can never opt out.
